question: Among adults with hypertension, does home blood pressure monitoring with remote team support, compared with usual follow-up, reduce clinic systolic blood pressure at 12 weeks?
population: Adults with hypertension in a wholly synthetic trial scenario
intervention: Home blood pressure monitoring with remote team review and support
comparator: Usual clinic follow-up without the remote support program
direction: Intervention minus control; negative values favor lower systolic BP under remote support
eligible_designs: Parallel randomized two-arm trials with independent participants
